Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with a wrist fracture
that is consistent with the mechanism of injury described. Over the course of 17
visits, care followed a typical progression of immobilization, serial imaging, hand
therapy, and gradually increasing range-of-motion work. Visit frequency tapered as the
patient improved and was reduced to periodic follow-up once function returned toward
baseline. On examination, localized tenderness and reduced grip strength over the
affected wrist support the reported injury, while neurovascular testing and the
remaining orthopedic screening tests were within normal limits. The patient reports a
remote minor strain in the same region years ago, which resolved completely without
lasting limitation and does not appear to account for the current presentation.
Billing records reflect single, appropriately spaced charges for each service with no
duplicate entries.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
